Town Clerk & Tax Collector 
   (opens in new window) Click the icon to access online services for vehicle registration renewals and estimates, dog re-licensing, property tax and water/sewer payments, and 
 vital records requests. 
********************** *** ***************** 
   Town  Clerk & Tax Collector Office 
Walk-In Office Hours 
 Monday 9am-2pm 
Tuesday 9am-2pm 
Thursday 9am-6pm 
 Registrations for newly-purchased vehicles must be completed in-person during our walk-in hours. 
 Services Available by Phone, Dropbox and Email 
 Monday, Tuesday & Friday 9am-4pm 
Thursday 9am-7pm 
Wednesday Closed 
Walk-in  hours are available for all transactions.    We encourage residents to utilize online, mail, and drop box services for your convenience. 
Our goal is to make sure we are able to deliver the quick service the mail, drop-box and online customers expect, as well as efficiently helping our in-person customers.  
    ******************************************* 
The Town Clerk & Tax Collector's Office is responsible for processing motor vehicle registrations, and the recording and management of all town vital records, meeting minutes and dog licenses. It is also accountable for conducting all local, state and federal elections as well as voter registration and absentee ballot requests. In addition the office collects all tax monies including: property; yield; excavation; and current use change taxes as well as Wilton water and sewer bill payments.
